notes.title: Cyber Manhunt 2: New World - The Wait is Over, Full Release is Here!
notes.content:
Hey there, Cyber Detectives!

We’re thrilled to announce that Cyber Manhunt 2: New World is now officially in full release!

With the addition of Chapter 5, Cyber Manhunt 2: New World has reached its complete version, and we couldn’t be more excited to share it with you. This latest chapter brings the total estimated playtime to approximately [b]10–13 hours[/b], offering an even richer and more immersive experience!
To celebrate the launch, we’re offering an [b]exclusive 12% discount[/b] for the first two weeks, bringing the price down to just [b]$8.79 USD[/b].
Additionally, players who own the first game can enjoy the [b]Cyber Manhunt Complete Saga Bundle[/b], which come with an [b]extra 15% discount[/b] on top of the launch promotion!
Don’t wait too long—these offers are only available during the two-week launch promotion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/0c7d94e4010ebc1ea00fe05e0841d19db67ff67c.png[/img]

[h1]Watch Our Thrilling launch trailer![/h1]

[previewyoutube=IXz7CayhVKw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]About The Game[/h1]

Since its Early Access debut, Cyber Manhunt 2: New World has received widespread acclaim from players and media alike for its intense, thrilling social engineering gameplay and its thought-provoking exploration of societal issues. On Steam, the game boasts an impressive [b]93% "Overwhelmingly Positive" rating[/b].
Building upon the world established by its predecessor, the game delves deeper into the profound impacts of rapid advancements in the internet and AI technologies in an era where "data is power."

In Cyber Manhunt 2: New World, players take on the role of an AI detective, tasked with unraveling digital mysteries and uncovering hidden truths. Employ real-world social engineering tactics and AI-driven investigative techniques to solve complex, intriguing puzzles and uncover layers of a gripping narrative. Every revelation not only leads to shocking discoveries but also exposes a vast, deeply interconnected conspiracy.

[h1]Become A "True Hacker"[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/b1d323bff4031c78ed1e7037791bbd122634d901.png[/img]

Immerse yourself in the digital realm as an AI detective, uncovering deep-seated mysteries inspired by real-world incidents. Experience the thrill of solving intricate puzzles that demand clever thinking and strategic planning.

[h1]Advanced Hacking Techniques[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/f45a5742730949e5c66b9dc30cc40a3f01fe11fa.png[/img]

From basic techniques to more sophisticated methods like voice masking, embody the essence of a true hacker. These varied tactics, ranging from password cracking to crafting digital personas, are essential in successfully navigating and solving each intricate case.

[h1]Compelling, Interwoven Story[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/8050c765f492486940100096c096611cb42fce59.png[/img]

Dive into a narrative that draws its inspiration from real-world events, where each chapter seamlessly contributes to an overarching and intricate plot. Experience the emotional and psychological intricacies of each character, leading you through a complex web of conspiracy.

[h1]A Spectrum of Lives[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/4850d17396a7a607660c1a2886f8392e40e732b6.png[/img]

Encounter a diverse cast of unique individuals, each representing different societal roles, motives, and histories. In this era of advanced AI, uncover the secrets they conceal, exposing the multifaceted nature of their digital lives—where there’s always more than meets the eye.

[h1]Upcoming Updates![/h1]

In the future, we’ll be releasing a [b]free update[/b] for the DLC desktop pet, along with the [b]free launch[/b] of the Cyber Manhunt 2: New World original soundtrack.
Stay tuned for more updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/faa9cc41593abad506b3a9f3a2d380359e9e4ddb.png[/img]

If you’re ready to immerse yourself in a thrilling journey of investigation and privacy invasion while exploring profound reflections on humanity, technology, and moral choices, we invite you to dive into the story-driven puzzle game [b]Cyber Manhunt 2: New World[/b].

Be sure to follow our official accounts below to stay updated with the latest game news and updates.

[b]Welcome To The New World![/b]

notes.title: Introducing Our New Game!
notes.content:
Hello Cyber Enthusiasts!

How have you been? It's been an incredible journey since we first released Cyber Manhunt back in 2021. Time flies! We can't thank you enough for the incredible support and valuable feedback you've given us since then. 

And today, we’ve got something to share with all of you. We are excited to bring to you the much-anticipated sequel to the game — [b]Cyber Manhunt: New World! [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2421410
[h2]Our Gripping Announcement Trailer![/h2]
[previewyoutube=RVMGl3zyoCc;full][/previewyoutube]
What’s more, [b]a free demo for the game is now available for you to play on Steam[/b]. For those of you who ventured deep into the enigmatic corridors of Cyber Manhunt, you know the thrill of unraveling the dark corners of the digital world. And if you're new to the game, fret not, you're in for an experience that's both captivating and thought-provoking!

[h3]About The Game[/h3]
Set against a backdrop reminiscent of its predecessor, Cyber Manhunt: New World immerses you in an engrossing cyber hacking narrative that resonates with the challenges of today's digital society. Play as an AI in a major corporation and navigate profound real-world challenges centered on big data, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence. Deploy an arsenal of intricate social engineering tactics to decipher concealed mysteries - while delving in tales shrouded in ambition and intrigue.

[h3]Key Features[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/b3e9261f0decc0df0d5843d24024ab492747f416.gif[/img]
[b]Real-World Inspired Storylines:[/b] Immerse yourself in an authentic virtual environment where you take on the role of an AI assistant and execute elaborate social engineering assignments inspired from actual hacking incidents.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/1c27e55cc1315f838632d7760024dfa05d66ec3e.gif[/img]
[b]Advanced Hacking Techniques:[/b] From foundational methods like password cracking and phishing to more sophisticated techniques such as voice manipulation and server penetration, Experience and utilize authentic hacking strategies as you progress through the complexities of the stories.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/883654aa04e85d3e6b2c62f23d5233278d14a0f5.png[/img]
[b]A Spectrum of Lives:[/b] Engage with a rich tapestry of characters from various socio-cultural backgrounds. In a world ruled by AI dominance, each character has a story to tell, secrets to reveal, and motivations to understand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38295660/d42d4992687b43b80439f5b281e72d3f37e15a6e.png[/img]

[b]Engrossing, Interconnected Narrative:[/b] Every chapter, deeply rooted in real-life events, tells a unique story while contributing to a larger narrative tapestry. Delve deep into the emotional turmoil and psychological struggles of each character, influencing the narrative with your decisions.

But don't just take our word for it. Dive into the free demo now and unravel the mysteries of a world where ambition meets deception, and AI intersects with humanity. 

Building on the experience and lessons learned from the first game, we've optimized various aspects such as game interactions, processes, and visual design to deliver an even more immersive and engaging experience. Your feedback will be invaluable as we continue to refine and enhance the game, and we look forward to your insights about the demo!

As we gear up for this new adventure, we kindly ask for your continued support. If Cyber Manhunt: New World resonates with you, we would be grateful if you could add it to your Steam wishlist. Spreading the word by sharing it on your socials or recommending it to a friend who might enjoy it would mean a lot to us. Thank you for your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2421410/_/

And if you haven’t already, be sure to follow us on Steam and Twitter to be notified of any new updates!
